title: TensorPlate Agent Local Control API
description: Versioned request/response envelope spoken by `tensorplate-agent` on its local control transport (Unix domain socket by default; see `docs/architecture/agent-control-api.md`). The CLI and any local operator tooling speak this contract — never the serving worker's data-plane HTTP directly. Wire encoding is newline-delimited JSON: one request object terminated by `\n`, one response object terminated by `\n`, on a freshly-connected socket. Concurrent conflicting mutating requests are rejected with `agent_busy`.

correlation_id.description: Optional caller-supplied correlation id. Echoed in the response and persisted with the transaction record. Auto-assigned when absent.

op.description: Operation discriminator. `undeploy` retires one resident-set member and `recover` returns a quarantined member to service; both name the member in their payload.

bundle_path.description: Absolute path to the bundle directory on the local device. The agent verifies the manifest before any worker interaction.

deployment_id.description: Operator-supplied identifier for this deployment intent, and the stable name of the resident-set member it deploys. It is reused by `status`, `rollback`, `undeploy`, `recover` and CLI display.

expected_bundle_digest.description: Optional caller-supplied expected bundle (manifest) digest. When present, the agent enforces digest equality before staging.

labels.description: Operator labels copied into the desired-state record for observability/status filtering.

set_operation.description: `replace` (the default, and what an absent field means) deploys `deployment_id` in place of the current deployment: today's singleton semantics, and a new generation of that member in a resident set. `add` admits an additional member beside the committed set. In a set of more than one member, `replace` must name a current member. Writers omit the field for `replace`.

admission_mode.description: Operator-only. `production` (what an absent field means) admits the member under its validated session counts. `qualification` admits a structurally valid bundle under the explicit `test_count` instead and records it as unqualified; the test count is a stream session count, so the agent refuses it without `streaming`. Refused on every speech client path.

test_count.description: Operator-only. The member's session count in qualification mode, which becomes its quota's `session_count` and so is at most 2048, the `MemberQuota.session_count` ceiling; required with `admission_mode` `qualification` and refused without it.

evidence_ref.description: Operator-only. The approved evidence reference an ordinary (production) activation of a qualified configuration uses; refused in qualification mode.

streaming.description: `true` starts every generation of the deployment with its stream listener on the stream port the agent holds for that generation, and reports the endpoint in status. Absent or `false` serves unary requests only; writers omit the field when false. Refused as `config_invalid` before staging for a bundle whose model class is not `speech`, and when the agent's configuration holds no stream ports (`worker.serving_port_range`). A speech worker serving streams refuses unary `/infer`.

reason.description: Operator-supplied reason persisted with the rollback transaction.

deployment_id.description: The member to roll back to its retained previous generation. Required when the resident set has more than one member; absent means the singleton rollback.

MemberRequest.description: Payload of `undeploy` and `recover`: the member they act on.

reason.description: Operator-supplied reason persisted with the transaction.

DeploymentId.description: One filesystem-safe path segment: the stable name of a deployment and of the resident-set member it becomes.

status.description: Coarse outcome. `busy` is returned when a conflicting transaction is in progress; `unavailable` is returned when the requested operation (e.g., rollback with no previous active) cannot be served right now.

transaction_id.description: Transaction id assigned by the agent. Stable across reconnects until the transaction reaches a terminal state.

control_features.description: Control operations this agent executes beyond the singleton deploy and rollback. A client sends a request that depends on one only when the agent lists it, because an agent that predates a request field ignores it: `set_operation_add` (`deploy` with `set_operation` `add`), `member_rollback` (`rollback` naming a `deployment_id`), `deploy_streaming` (`deploy` with `streaming`, listed by an agent whose configuration gives stream ports) and `deploy_qualification` (`deploy` with `admission_mode` `qualification` and its `test_count`, listed with `deploy_streaming`). Absent means none. Readers ignore names they do not know.

ResidentSetStatus.description: The committed resident set, one entry per member in committed order. Present only when the agent's durable state records a set. When the set has exactly one member and it is serving, the singleton `active` (and `previous_active`, from its retained generation) describe the same member, with `serving_url` when its unary endpoint is `http://127.0.0.1:<port>` or `http://localhost:<port>` with no path, so clients that read only `active` keep working on it when `active` carries `serving_url`; with more members `active` is absent. A client that finds this object but no `active.serving_url` has no single unary route to discover and must not assume a default.

MemberStatus.description: One resident-set member at its committed generation. `process`, `readiness`, `draining` and `contact` say how the worker process of that generation stands now; all four are absent when the agent's worker control does not report its processes. `effective_quota` is the quota the member's worker answered its last `activate` with, while its process runs, and absent once an `activate` is answered `error`. Fields whose source does not exist yet are absent: `stream_api_version` until the stream endpoint lands, and `staged_bytes` until staging is keyed by generation.

state.description: `quarantined` members hold their generation for `recover` or `undeploy` and serve nothing.

admission_mode.description: `qualification` members are unqualified: admitted under an operator test count, never a support claim.

quota.description: The session quota committed for the member.

unary_endpoint.description: Where the member serves unary requests, from the committed endpoint map; absent for a stream-only or quarantined member.

stream_endpoint.description: Where the member serves streams, from the committed endpoint map; absent for a unary-only or quarantined member.

effective_quota.description: The quota the member's worker answered its last `activate` with, absent once one is answered `error`; it may be lower than `quota`.

contact.description: Whether the agent's polls of the member's worker are being answered: `out_of_contact` once three polls in a row went unanswered. Absent for a generation with no process and for one that is draining.

process.description: Whether the worker process of this generation is running under the agent. `stopped` when the agent holds no running process for it: it exited, it was stopped, or it has not been started.

readiness.description: Whether the agent has judged this generation ready: its worker reported the member's model ready while answering on its control channel. It is the agent's last judgement, made when the generation was warmed or restarted, not a reading taken for this status. `not_ready` whenever `process` is `stopped`.

draining.description: The agent has asked this generation's worker to stop and its process has not been reaped. A draining worker finishes what it accepted inside its drain deadline; a reader opens nothing new on it, whatever `readiness` says.

MemberQuota.description: Session quota the agent assigned to the member: the concurrent session count (at most 2048, the most sessions one member's ledger reports) and the per-domain session quota bytes that back it. In qualification mode `session_count` is the operator's test count. A member that serves no logical sessions carries zero sessions and no domain bytes.

DomainQuotaBytes.description: Session quota bytes per budget domain. `shared_pool` (unified memory) never appears beside `guest_ram` or `device_vram` (discrete accelerator).

desired_device_index.description: Requested accelerator pin. When desired_active is present, an absent pin means an unpinned worker is requested. When desired_active is absent, no worker is requested.

actual_device_index.description: Accelerator pin used to launch the running worker. When actual_active is present, an absent pin means the worker is unpinned; when actual_active is absent, no worker is running. The actual and desired pins can differ during initial launch, restart, or a placement change.

generation.description: The deployment's generation, when the agent knows it: for `active`, the generation of the worker serving at `serving_url`, read together with that URL; for `candidate`, the generation being prepared; for `previous_active`, the generation the retained deployment was last started as, when its record names a deployment descriptor; for a slot projected from a resident set, the member's committed generation. Absent otherwise.

serving_url.description: Loopback data-plane URL for the active worker. Present only for the active deployment: when the agent owns a concrete serving process, or, for a resident set whose only member serves, the `/infer` URL of the member's committed unary endpoint when that endpoint is `http://127.0.0.1:<port>` or `http://localhost:<port>` with no path.

stream_endpoint.description: Where the active worker serves stream sessions, as `host:port`. Present only for the active deployment, while the generation serving it was started with streaming; that generation is `generation`.

descriptor_digest.description: The digest a stream Open names for the active worker: the deployment descriptor's digest, or for a format 0.1 bundle the manifest's digest. The worker echoes it and verifies nothing. Present exactly when `stream_endpoint` is.

admission_mode.description: The mode the active deployment was admitted under, as its deployment descriptor records it, or for a slot projected from a resident set as the member does. `qualification` is unqualified: admitted under an operator test count, never a support claim. Present only for the active deployment, and absent when it has no descriptor (a format 0.1 bundle), when its descriptor cannot be read, and when it records a qualification session count outside 1 to 2048.

test_count.description: The operator's test count a qualification deployment was admitted under: its session count. Present exactly when `admission_mode` is `qualification`.
